user_summary: A restrained, evidence-first visual direction for a single-page portfolio: a text-dominant hero, one signature diagram illustrating the project's reliability design, and calm typography throughout.

visual_language.creative_thesis: Reliability engineering as its own aesthetic: restrained, high-contrast, evidence-first.
visual_language.visual_metaphor: Precision instrumentation — clean lines, no ornament, every element earns its place.
visual_language.color_behavior: A single confident accent (used only for evidence and the primary action) against a high-contrast neutral base.
visual_language.typography: A calm, confident display/body hierarchy with generous vertical rhythm; headlines read as statements, not marketing copy.
visual_language.grid_and_spacing: Wide, breathable spacing rhythm; content never crowds the edges.
visual_language.motion_character: Minimal — reserved for the one signature evidence moment.
visual_language.accessibility_principles: WCAG AA contrast minimum; no information exists only inside motion.
visual_language.anti_patterns: No gradients, no glassmorphism, no decorative motion, no stock-photo hero imagery.

shared_visual_systems.card_treatment: Flat, bordered panels with no drop shadow.
shared_visual_systems.evidence_framing: Claims are always paired with their source context, never presented in isolation.

signature_moments: a staged reveal of the retry/backoff diagram as it enters the viewport

interaction_system.hover: subtle lift on the project evidence panel

pages.visitor_takeaway: Priya designs and ships infrastructure that other engineers depend on.
pages.first_impression: A confident, text-dominant hero with an abstract diagrammatic accent balancing the headline.
pages.storyboard: Hero establishes positioning, then the project evidence with a supporting diagram, then a closing contact action.
pages.primary_emphasis: the project evidence and its supporting diagram
pages.secondary_emphasis: the about section's professional identity summary
pages.responsive_summary: Single column on mobile; hero becomes centered instead of asymmetric; diagram simplifies to a vertical flow.

scenes.layout_intent: Text-dominant asymmetric hero; the visual occupies roughly one-third of the desktop composition.
scenes.background_intent: A subtle structural grid texture, low contrast.
scenes.responsive_behavior: Single column, centered, on mobile; asymmetric two-column layout on desktop.
scenes.accessibility_intent: Headline contrast exceeds WCAG AA; no motion required to read the hero.
acceptance_criteria: Headline and positioning are legible without scrolling on a standard mobile viewport.

scenes.narrative_goal: Feature the strongest project as evidence, with a diagram in place of a missing screenshot.
scenes.layout_intent: Framed evidence panel beside the project narrative; diagram occupies the panel.

motion_intent.purpose: draw attention to the diagram as it enters view

scenes.reduced_motion_behavior: Diagram appears immediately, fully visible, with no entrance animation.
scenes.responsive_behavior: Stacks vertically on mobile; diagram simplifies from horizontal to vertical flow.
scenes.performance_risk: low — the diagram is a lightweight SVG, not raster media.
scenes.failure_safe_static_state: The diagram is fully legible and meaningful without any motion.
acceptance_criteria: The diagram communicates the retry/backoff flow without requiring the accompanying prose.
The page reads as complete and confident with zero real project imagery.

asset_briefs.purpose: Illustrate the project's retry/backoff design in place of a missing screenshot.
asset_briefs.desktop_treatment: framed panel beside the project narrative
asset_briefs.fallback_strategy: Fall back to a short bulleted description of the retry/backoff design if the diagram cannot be produced.
asset_briefs.alt_text_intent: Describes the retry/backoff flow structure, not just 'diagram'.

resource_candidates.why_it_matches: The project's retry/backoff design is naturally a step sequence.
resource_candidates.possible_use: Adapt the process-flow pattern to show the retry/backoff decision sequence.

accessibility_and_performance.contrast: WCAG AA minimum for all text.
accessibility_and_performance.reduced_motion: No motion is load-bearing anywhere on the page.
accessibility_and_performance.performance: No raster hero image; the only non-text asset is a lightweight SVG diagram.
